# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v1 c15 P20](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0020), [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a dark and gloomy small face with black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony is a clever and independent boy who forms his own opinions. He exhibits a cheeky, insolent, and sullen demeanor, often showing disdain toward female teachers. However, he is capable of showing respect once he believes it has been earned through firm discipline.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P36](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0036), [v2 c1 P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P40](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0040), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Abilities

- Academic aptitude  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 c1 P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)</sub>

## History

Anthony Tulk attended Brierley school, where he was advanced to the fifth class alongside Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow. He joined the Regent's entrance class under Miss Thorne, though he missed roles in school performances. When Nell took over teaching at Brierley, Anthony displayed an insolent and disdainful attitude toward her authority, asserting that female teachers were useless. His misbehavior culminated in him putting a mouse in Nell's desk drawer. Nell lost her temper and whipped him, which earned his unexpected respect. From then on, Anthony became polite, helped carry Nell's books, and admitted he thought she had some worth. He later fought with other boys in defense of Nell's reputation.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v2 c1 P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P29](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0029), [v2 c12 P34](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0034), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)_
